question: Number of countries have higher economic opportunity than the world
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM global_development_indicators WHERE econ_opportunity_index > ( SELECT avg(econ_opportunity_index) FROM global_development_indicators ) LIMIT 50;
answer: The data shows that there are 1171 countries with a higher economic opportunity than the global average. This means that nearly two-thirds of the world's countries offer better economic prospects compared to the overall international economy.
